lesson_title: A New Map on the Wall
hook_text: A brand-new map of Africa goes up on the wall. Where are you on it?
clip_script: Upington, Northern Cape. A new school year, and a big map of Africa is unrolled on the classroom wall. Geography is the study of places, people and the environment. This year: map skills, physical features, weather, and mining. First, a quick check: north, east, south, west, Never Eat Soggy Weet-Bix. North is at the top of the map. A globe is round, a map is flat. And right at the bottom of Africa: South Africa, our home.
visual_style: Whiteboard classroom wall with a map of Africa unrolling, a compass rose drawing itself, and a globe spinning beside it.
mood: Fresh and curious, like the first day of a big adventure.
pacing: Quick opening on the map, slow down for the compass rose, end on South Africa.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find your own town on a map of Africa.
